items.text: My office has received multiple constituent cases from healthcare workers whose personal doctors urged medical exemptions from the shot, but were denied medical exemptions by their employers. These are the same healthcare workers who have been on the frontlines from day one.

People shouldn't have to endure the stress of deciding between whether to get a shot or keep their job, especially healthcare workers who know COVID better than anyone. My heart goes out to every person put in this terrible situation, and I pledge to continue fighting for them.

Thank you for your hard work on this issue @RogerMarshallMD. I have filed the discharge petition in the House, and urge all of my Republican and Democrat colleagues to sign it immediately in order to protect the rights of our healthcare workers.

COVID is essentially over for illegal immigrants at the southern border (with Biden ending the Title 42 COVID restriction), but our military & CMS healthcare workers are still forced to get the shot. It's time to end the insanity & reverse all COVID restrictions on Americans.
